payload.reason: The evidence indicates that PARENT correlates better with human judgments compared to other text generation metrics, specifically in various settings including the WebNLG challenge and WikiBio datasets.

claims.text: PARENT correlates with human judgments better than existing text generation metrics.
Both variants of PARENT show significantly better correlation with human judgments compared to other metrics.
PARENT shows the highest correlation with humans across a range of settings with divergent references.
